summary: The secret comes out: {reporter} is waiting where you did not expect, and asks where you have been and with whom.
realLife: One life: In 2009 the South Carolina governor told staff he was hiking but was in Argentina with his mistress. A reporter met him at the airport and he admitted the affair. He repaid the state for travel, faced ethics charges, and his wife filed for divorce. Another: He denied an affair until reporters caught him at a hotel in 2008. He admitted it but denied fathering the child, and an aide claimed paternity; in 2010 he admitted he was the father, and his wife separated from him. Another: When a tape of his running mate's lewd remarks came out in 2016, he said he could not defend them but stayed on the ticket, and declined to stand in for Trump at an event.
